SOM.note: Central bank's role not stated; only mobile payment providers described as licensed, without naming the licensor.
Nothing on consumer protection rules or complaints.
Remittance inflows named only as a share of GDP, with no channel or corridor.
Only an investment agency's ICT and digital strategy and the 9th National Development Plan are named, neither a national strategy with standing stated.
Nothing on government payments to people.

facts.fact: The U.S. International Trade Administration guide says Somalia has two existing fibre systems linking it to the global internet, the EASSy cable (10 Tb/s) and the DARE1 cable (100G); a third, 2Africa, is under development.

SOM.note: Only a January 2021 figure of 12.1 percent, outside the 2024 window and with no stated survey source.
Gives mobile money use and phone use for transactions, not a survey share of adults with an account.

facts.fact: The U.S. International Trade Administration guide says mobile money is widespread in Somalia, at an estimated 73 percent market penetration, with three licensed mobile payment providers linked to the biggest mobile operators.

SOM.note: Nothing on electronic payment of taxes or fees.
